1. The specific change in the construction operation

The candidate’s central operation is:

Keep the jam and its opposing load inside one retained unit; remove that unit through separate, inspected outer interfaces.

That avoids requiring a damaged pin, cam, or frictional contact to reverse its original engagement while loaded. It also avoids interpreting zero remote force as proof that the internal contact is unloaded.

This is narrower than claiming invention of shoring, load transfer, cutting, replacement, or proof loading. Those operations already appear in US8997873B2 and the earlier robotic-bypass disclosure US20090095522A1. The candidate contribution would have to be the manufactured containment boundary, observable separation, accessible transport, and repeatable restoration integrated into an unattended construction service. I have not established patent novelty. 
Google Patents
+1

The new arrangement has three main elements:

Exterior field connections. Replaceable bars lie in two exterior longitudinal planes. Transverse crossframes are factory welded and inspected.
Captured connection cartridges. Both shoes of the failed engagement, including the admitted opposing internal contact, enter one mechanically retained cage.
Independent ground support and observable return. A separate holder supports a selected crossframe. Its two clamp pads can be adjusted and unloaded independently.

The machine is consequently a substantial industrial cell. It does not obtain a portable or low-mass advantage by assigning heavy maintenance machinery to the finished frame.

title: Keep the failed contact and opposing load inside one retained unit
